entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can manipulate the world of dreams, even in your physical form.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 17, Ephemeral Tread, Lucid Dreamer, Knowledge (planes) 10 ranks.

Benefit(s): When in the Dimension of Dreams in your physical body, you gain an additional attempt at an impossible action per day, for a total of two attempts.

However, as a result of your meddling with the fabric of the realm, when you travel to the Dimension of Dreams in your physical body, you must succeed at a DC 15 Charisma check or arrive at a disadvantage.
